Class AmwpFacade

java.lang.Object
org.aetheris.ssh.AmwpFacade
@Component public class AmwpFacade extends Object
The AmwpFacade class is the server AMWP Scope A handler. Bantha Roux is RAM only. Cell turns go to that RAM region. Cells never enter the VT100 Roux. The execute semaphore holds 3 permits. Lane.LLM_EXEC stays a pool of 4 threads.
invalid reference 
ChatShell
does not take this semaphore. A caller sends frames through handle(String, AmwpFrame, AmwpFacade.AmwpReplySink). A caller sends one console turn through completeTurn(String, AmwpToon.ExecuteBody, List). A tool frame is refused.

  • Constructor Details

    • AmwpFacade

      public AmwpFacade(RouxChatMemory rouxMemory, LlmRouter llmRouter, Lamina lamina, CasseroleProperties properties, GrokLlmService grokLlm, @Value("${spring.ai.ollama.chat.options.num-ctx:0}") int numCtx, @Value("${spring.ai.ollama.base-url:http://localhost:11434}") String ollamaBaseUrl, @Value("${spring.ai.ollama.chat.options.model:}") String ollamaModel)
      The constructor stores the collaborators and builds the maps. The execute semaphore starts with 3 permits. A null Ollama model is stored as empty. A model value is trimmed. The base URL loses one trailing slash through trimSlash(String). The pool chat is a new PoolChatServer for these properties.
      Parameters:
      rouxMemory - The memory is the Roux chat memory.
      llmRouter - The router is the provider map.
      lamina - The lamina is the lane pool.
      properties - The properties are the server settings.
      grokLlm - The service lists Grok language models. A null service answers the catalog with the header only.
      numCtx - The number is spring.ai.ollama.chat.options.num-ctx. 0 omits num_ctx.
      ollamaBaseUrl - The URL is spring.ai.ollama.base-url. Empty uses http://localhost:11434.
      ollamaModel - The model is spring.ai.ollama.chat.options.model. Empty stays empty.

    • initFacts

      public byte[] initFacts()
      The initFacts method builds the init body for this process. The air-gap word comes from AetherisYaml.readProcessHome(). The body also carries the server num-ctx integer, the managed-token count, and the head count. The bytes are AmwpToon.encodeFacts(String, int).
      Returns:
      The return value is the session-facts text.

    • openBantha

      public OpenResult openBantha(String user)
      The openBantha method opens the RAM Bantha region for this user. The method does not take a file lock. RegionOwner.sanitize(String) prepares the user name. An IllegalArgumentException returns OpenResult.refused(String) with invalid username. Any other user opens banthaRegion(String) through RouxChatMemory.openRam(String).
      Parameters:
      user - The user is the SSH user.
      Returns:
      The return value is the open result.

    • handle

      public void handle(String user, AmwpFrame frame, AmwpFacade.AmwpReplySink replyTo)
      The handle method accepts one Scope A, stream, or tool frame. A null frame returns without a reply. A null sink returns without a reply. A keepalive returns without a reply. A tool frame replies failed and no tool is invocable, then returns. A cancel drops the live token, cancels the cell HTTP call, and cancels the in-flight task. A type other than data returns without a reply. A channel A body that starts with show: is answered off the execute path. A channel A body that starts with tags: is answered off the execute path. A channel A body that starts with grok_models: is answered off the execute path. A cell that is already running replies cell-busy. Any other data frame takes a new token and waits for an execute permit. The waiter thread is named aetheris-execute-wait and is a daemon. The task lane is Lane.LLM_EXEC and the task name is aetheris-execute. The task releases the permit in finally.
      Parameters:
      user - The user is the SSH user.
      frame - The frame is the inbound frame.
      replyTo - The sink is the mux writer.

    • completeTurn

      public String completeTurn(String user, AmwpToon.ExecuteBody req, List<org.springframework.ai.chat.messages.Message> messages) throws Exception
      The completeTurn method runs one console turn. The method does not take an execute permit. The method does not send an AMWP frame. doorBanner(String, AmwpToon.ExecuteBody) throws Exception when it returns text. A null message list is built by assembleMessages(AmwpToon.ExecuteBody). Any other list is copied, and placeHost(List) inserts the configured system prompt when that text is absent. holdRoux(String, String, long, List) stores the prompt with a null cell key. routedComplete(String, String, long, byte[], AmwpFacade.AmwpReplySink, AmwpToon.ExecuteBody, List, boolean) runs with the cell flag false. An empty reply is returned. The caller decides that the text is empty.
      Parameters:
      user - The user is the SSH user.
      req - The request holds the family, the options, and the shell pool boot.
      messages - The messages are the console transcript.
      Returns:
      The return value is the assistant text.
      Throws:
      Exception - The exception is the banner, or the provider failure.

    • cancelPool

      public void cancelPool(String user)
      The cancelPool method stops the in-flight pool prompt for this SSH user. A null user returns without a call. An empty user returns without a call. The child stays up.
      Parameters:
      user - The user is the SSH user.

    • sendConsoleText

      public void sendConsoleText(String user, String text)
      The sendConsoleText method writes channel A text for a console. The VT100 grid is not written. The caller passes the sanitized user. This method does not sanitize again. A null or empty user returns without writing. A null text returns without writing. A missing sink returns without writing. The payload is AmwpCodec.scopeAPayload(int, int, byte[], byte[]) with a null cell id. A send failure is ignored.
      Parameters:
      user - The user is the sanitized SSH user.
      text - The text is the reply body.
